{{Short description|Sets defined using mathematical category theory}}

'''Categorical set theory''' is any one of several versions of [[set theory]] developed from or treated in the context of mathematical [[category theory]]. Its basis originated with the development of [[Elementary theory of the category of sets|ETCS]] by [[William Lawvere]] in 1964.<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Osius |first=Gerhard |date=February 1974 |title=Categorical set theory: A characterization of the category of sets |url=https://linkinghub.elsevier.com/retrieve/pii/0022404974900322 |journal=Journal of Pure and Applied Algebra |language=en |volume=4 |issue=1 |pages=79–119 |doi=10.1016/0022-4049(74)90032-2|url-access=subscription }}</ref>
